name: Extra Ranger Talent (Open Design LLC)
body:
You have more ranger talents than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Ranger talent class feature.

Benefit(s): You may choose an additional ranger talent.

Special: You can gain Extra Ranger Talent multiple times.

You must select a different talent each time.

The Expanded Spell-less Ranger, © 2013, Open Design LLC; Author: Marc Radle.
